column7: ApproveMFAReset returned without a DENIED mfa.reset_approved row for several refusals decided before its transaction (request expired, requester no longer an active global admin, target IdP-linked, blocked, a global admin or over the rank ceiling, approver without a second factor), so the same refusal was audited only when it landed inside the approval transaction. Each now writes the DENIED row; the test covers every case except the rank ceiling (REVIEW-3860-DEEP-1 L1).
